summary: The change isolates the targeted health, logging, embeddings, and Codex capacity failures without changing the response shapes.

evidence: Embeddings cache and input reads now treat individual KV rejections as misses, while input cleanup uses Promise.allSettled.
Terminal logging waits for all writes with Promise.allSettled, so one rejected write does not abort the group.
Provider health failures become unknown views and quota-read failures become null; Codex capacity failures are handled per account.
